---
title: "Goonj Rahi Hai Ye Sada Ya Hussain"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

goonj rahi hai ye sada ya hussain
tujhko layeeno ne sataya hussain
ya hussain, ya hussain

teen shabo roz ka pyasa hussain
dashte bala may tujhe maara hussain
ya hussain, ya hussain

bayyate fasiq ke talabgaar thay
zulmo sitam ke liye tayyar thay
kitne tere sar ke khareedar thay
tune magar sar na jhukaya hussain
ya hussain, ya hussain

bhej ke khat tujko bulaaya gaya
tera watan tujse chudaya gaya
khabr se nana ki hataya gaya
paykare tasleemo raza ya hussain
ya hussain, ya hussain

karbobala ghayr ke laaye tujhe
tere azeez akhroba saath thay
nehr se qaime bhi hataye gaye
uzr zara bhi na hua ya hussain
ya hussain, ya hussain

dasht may thodi si jagah mil gaye
aamade aada se zameen hil gaye
aur nazar jab sue saahil gaye
us pa layeeno ka tha pehra hussain
ya hussain, ya hussain

kya shabe aashoor ka hangaam tha
saara jahan larza barandaam tha
tujhko ibadat se faqad kaam tha
karta raha zikr khuda ka hussain
ya hussain, ya hussain

suboh dahum ka ho bhala kya bayaan
dene laga jab tera akbar azaan
jaise thi awaaze nabi begumaan
karbobala thi ke madina hussain
ya hussain, ya hussain

fauje hussaini may bada josh tha
tune bhi pyaso ko sahara kiya
saaniye hyder lo alam dediya
sab ne unhe faqr se dekha hussain
ya hussain, ya hussain

suye imam ek namazi barha
dil se basad shaan e niyazi barha
fauje udoo se hure ghazi barha
aake qadam-bosh hua ya hussain
ya hussain, ya hussain

haaye muhibbe shahe aali maqaaam
jinka habib ibne mazaahir hai naam
zainabe dilgeer ne bheja salaam
tumne gale unko lagaya hussain
ya hussain, ya hussain

phir to ajab hashr bapa ho gaya
ek ke baad fida hogaya
dekhte hi dekhte kya hogaya
ab koi nasir na raha ya hussain
ya hussain, ya hussain

saaniye zehra ka bura haal tha
jab ke tadaruk na koi ban pada
auno mohammad ko fida kar diya
us pa bhi tu bach na saka ya hussain
ya hussain, ya hussain

madare qasim ka jigar dekhiye
jazbaye emaan ka asr dekhiye
bhej diya ran may pisar dekhiye
jo hua pamaale jafa ya hussain
ya hussain, ya hussain

hazrate abbas bhi marne chale
nehr par jarraar ke baazu kate
thaam ke aap apni kamar reh gaye
hogayi chup roke sakina hussain
ya hussain ya hussain

hogaye ruqsat ko shabihe rasool
ab shahe bekas thay bahot dil maloool
aayi kahin se ye sadaye batool
mai teri himmat pe fida ya hussain
ya hussain ya hussain

asghar-e-baysheer pe jaane fida
khainchay hue teer barha hurmala
khasta kalaame shehe wala hua
suye falak aap ne dekha hussain
ya hussain ya hussain

dhal gaya din aur qareeb aayi shaam
phir to akele thay imame anaam
dediya sar khatm kiya apna kaam
deene nabi khoob bachaya hussain
ya hussain ya hussain

assert all(len(r.splitlines()) == len(s.splitlines()) for r, s in zip(roman_blocks, source_blocks))
digit_map = str.maketrans('0123456789', '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹')
def number(blocks, digits=None):
    return '\\n\\n'.join(
        (str(index).translate(digits) + '\\n' if digits is not None else str(index) + '\\n') + block
        if index else block
        for index, block in enumerate(blocks)
    )
import re
names = r'\\b(hussain|karbobala|aashoor|akbar|hyder|madina|hure|habib|mazaahir|zainabe|zehra|auno|mohammad|qasim|abbas|sakina|batool|asghar|hurmala|khuda)\\b'
def roman_case(line):
    line = re.sub(names, lambda match: match[0].capitalize(), line)
    return line[:1].upper() + line[1:]
roman_numbered = number(['\\n'.join(map(roman_case, block.splitlines())) for block in roman_blocks])
assert [line.lower() for line in roman_numbered.splitlines() if line and not line.isdecimal()] == [line for line in roman.strip().splitlines() if line]
metadata = metadata.replace('title: \"Goonj Rahi Hai Ye Sada Ya Hussain\"', 'title: \"گونج رہی ہے یہ صدا یا حسین\"\\nalternateTitle: \"Goonj Rahi Hai Ye Sada Ya Hussain\"')
metadata = metadata.replace('direction: \"ltr\"', 'direction: \"rtl\"').replace('tags: [\"noUrdu\"]\\n', '')
roman_yaml = '\\n'.join('  ' + line if line else '' for line in roman_numbered.splitlines())
p.write_text('---' + metadata + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + roman_yaml + '\\n---\\n\\n' + number(source_blocks, digit_map) + '\\n')
print(sum(len(s.splitlines()) for s in source_blocks), 'matched verse lines')

item.text:
Reconstructed the [Urdu lyric](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/1/workspaces/77a847b1d10d4058ae66347f8bde69b0/src/data/lyrics/goonj-rahi-hai-ye-sada-ya-hussain-nw-2a6778f5169a.md) and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that all 86 verse lines align across the opening and 17 numbered stanzas. Updated the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous Roman spellings `ghayr`, `akhroba`, and `faqr` as گھیر، اقربا، and فخر in context.
